crossRefs.note: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

translations.web: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”
translations.bsb: But those standing nearby said, “How dare you insult the high priest of God!”
translations.kjv: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?
translations.asv: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?
